Package com.sca4d.auth.web

Class AuthRequestInterceptor

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.spring.web.HttpCallHandlerInterceptor
com.sca4d.auth.web.AuthRequestInterceptor
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerInterceptor
public class AuthRequestInterceptor extends com.sca4d.core.spring.web.HttpCallHandlerInterceptor
按 Controller 注解恢复 Session，并在参数绑定前拒绝未声明匿名访问的未认证请求。
